content.text: Before I add the cache, two choices are yours.

questions.question: Which database should the cache use?

options.label: Redis
options.description: In memory, shared by every worker

options.label: SQLite
options.description: A file beside the app, nothing to run

options.label: None for now
options.description: Ship without a cache and measure first

options.label: End-to-end
options.description: the real app, driven over its socket
